notes: the first link «أبی رحمه الله» is the compiler's father, written without a name: a bare relation (rule 7; cf. example 4)
the Companion Sahl speaks («سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ»): the Prophet is the end of the chain
Persian yeh and keheh in «أبی», «الکوفی», «الحسین» are kept as the text writes them
